title: Token SLI Fusion and Fallback Profiling — regional failover instrumentation & dashboards
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Background: We currently capture token-level decode latencies, regional admit/reject counts, and KV cache hit metrics in separate pipelines. Operators lack a fused view that attributes tail latency to admission throttles, KV misses, region failovers, or downstream decoding stalls. This ticket adds instrumentation and a dashboard mosaic that fuses these signals so on-call and SREs can quickly determine whether a p99 spike is due to gateway admission, cross-region fallback, or model decode regressions.

Scope:
- Define and emit a fused token-level SLI that tags each token with: admit_path, shard_id, kv_hit (boolean), decode_duration_ms, region_origin, fallback_reason (if rerouted), and route_variant.
- Add lightweight sampling (1% global, up to 10% for high-error customers) and a deterministic reservoir keyed by customer+route for reproducible traces.
- Extend the telemetry pipeline to join admit/KV/decode traces at the token_id level and produce derived metrics: token_path_latency_p50/p95/p99, kv_miss_rate_by_sequence_length, fallback_ratio_by_region, admit_reject_rate_by_customer_tier.
- Build a dashboard canvas that shows: fused latency waterfall (admit -> queue -> kv -> decode), heatmap of kv misses vs p99, region quarantine events timeline, and a drilldown for per-customer token traces.
- Add alerting rules and a short runbook for ‘region quarantine suspected’ that suggests steps (traffic quarantine, warmup, rollback).

Non-goals: define new SLO targets; that will be a follow-up with PMs once visibility is stable.
acceptance_criteria: Fused token SLI events are emitted for at least 95% of sampled tokens with required tags (admit_path, kv_hit, decode_duration_ms, region_origin, fallback_reason)
Derived metrics pipeline produces token_path_latency_p50/p95/p99 and kv_miss_rate_by_sequence_length that match sampled traces within 10% margin
Dashboard canvas created with annotated timeline, waterfall panels, kv-miss heatmap, and per-customer trace drilldowns
Alerts for fallback_ratio_by_region > 2% sustained for 5 minutes and admit_reject_rate_by_customer_tier > 1% exist with links to runbook
Sampling and reservoir logic reviewed and approved by Privacy & SRE (no PII retention)
implementation_notes: Emit a new telemetry event type 'token_fused' at the admission edge after KV lookup and just before dispatch to decode to ensure consistent tagging
Use existing telemetry pipeline join keys: request_id + token_index + trace_shard for correlation with minimal overhead
Add deterministic reservoir sampling implementation in the admission layer (seeded by customer_id) to support reproducible traces for debugging
Pipeline transformation to compute derived metrics should be implemented as a single Flink job to reduce cross-job joins
Dashboard will be implemented in Grafana using new 'telemetry-fused' datasource with clickable links to raw token traces stored in S3/backfilled TTL 30 days
